The steam holes appear somewhat shallow and lack the clean, drilled precision of real manufacturing. Some holes have slightly irregular rims, suggesting minor generative blurring or fusion at the edges.
The transition between the metal soleplate and the visible plastic body on the left is slightly ambiguous and soft, lacking a sharp mechanical seam.
